Name: Time Chapter - Enjoy the Moment One Pause at a Time
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Time Chapter [/b][/size][/center]

[center]Time stands still. Keep playing. Turn the page when you're ready.[/center]

[b][size=3]Playing a heavily modded Stardew Valley?[/size][/b]
[size=2]Tons of NPCs to meet, crops to water, animals to care for, places to explore, events to catch... and somehow the whole day is already gone?[/size]

[size=2]Maybe you've even installed time-speed mods and spent ages tweaking the day length until it almost feels right.[/size]

[b][size=3]Well, Time Chapter is my answer to that.[/size][/b]
[size=2]Instead of making the entire day painfully slow, Time Chapter gives you a few natural stopping points throughout the day.[/size]
[size=2]At 11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM and Midnight, [b] the clock pauses and simply waits for you. [/b][/size]

[size=3][b]But the valley keeps moving. [/b][/size]

[size=2]Keep farming. Keep fishing. Go mining. Visit those 30 modded NPCs you installed. Wander through your expansion maps. Finish your chores. Do absolutely nothing for a while if you want.[/size]

[size=2]When you're ready?[/size]

[b][size=3]Turn the page and continue your day.[/size][/b]
 
[b][size=3]WHAT TIME CHAPTER DOES[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Pauses time at 11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM and Midnight[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Each Chapter Break can be turned on or off[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]The clock stops — not the game[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]NPCs, farming, fishing, mining, combat and exploration keep working[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Hold T or click and hold the journal to continue[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Animated journal + clock HUD[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Smooth page-turn animation[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Random little atmosphere messages[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Vanilla Stardew sounds[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Move and resize the HUD however you like[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Works alongside slower-time / TimeSpeed-style mods[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Optional GMCM support[/size][/*]
[/list] 
[b][size=3]HOW IT WORKS [/size][/b]
[size=2]Play normally until the game reaches an enabled Chapter Break: 11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM or Midnight.[/size]
[size=2]When the journal-clock appears, keep playing for as long as you want — the clock is waiting for you.[/size]
[size=2]When you're ready to move on, hold T for about one second or click and hold the journal-clock.[/size]
[size=2]The page turns, time starts flowing again, and your day continues exactly where it left off.[/size]
 
[b][size=3]WHY TIME CHAPTER?[/size][/b]
[size=2]Big modlists can make Stardew feel surprisingly rushed. Between farm chores, custom NPCs, huge expansion maps, events, fishing, mines and everything else, sometimes you just want the game to wait for you for a little while.[/size]
[size=2]Time Chapter gives you those little breathing points without turning the whole game into a permanent time freeze.[/size]
[size=2][i]Don't worry about the clock. Enjoy the valley.[/i][/size]
[size=2]And when you're ready, turn the page.[/size]
 
[b][size=3]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b]
[size=2]Time Chapter is designed to stay out of the way of your other mods. It only controls its own clock pause and leaves NPC schedules, machines, shops, weather, lighting, maps and other gameplay systems alone.[/size]
[size=2]It is especially useful alongside slower-time / TimeSpeed-style mods: your time mod controls how fast the day moves, while Time Chapter simply gives you natural places to stop.[/size]
[size=2]If another mod legitimately changes the clock while a Chapter Break is active, Time Chapter lets go instead of fighting it.[/size]
 
[b][size=3]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]
[size=2]1. Install SMAPI[/size]
[size=2]2. Drop Time Chapter into your Mods folder[/size]
[size=2]3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI[/size]
[size=2]4. Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu for easy in-game settings[/size]
 

[b]🌱 MY OTHER MODS
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52335]Moody Farmer[/url] — Give your farmer a little personality, because not every day is a good day. Wake up with a different mood each morning, with cute icons and gameplay effects that can change how your day unfolds.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52548]Time Chapter[/url] — Give yourself a little breathing room when the day gets busy. Pause the clock, keep playing, and let the next chapter begin when you’re ready.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52511]Soap & Scrub[/url] — Sparkly when clean. Stinky when dirty. A lightweight hygiene system that adds a little extra life to your farmer without turning cleanliness into another meter you have to babysit.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52587]When Nature Calls[/url] — Eat. Drink. Carry Toilet Paper. A lightweight bathroom-need system where nature eventually calls, bathrooms suddenly matter, and waiting too long can turn a normal day into a desperate sprint home.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52632]Oops![/url] — Oops! adds a lightweight skill-based mistake system to Stardew Valley where your farmer actually feels inexperienced when they first arrive in the valley.[/b]

[center][b]Enjoying these mods?[/b][/center]
[center][b][i]If you like these mods, don't forget to leave an endorsement on Nexus — it really helps and lets me know you're enjoying the mod. ♥[/i][/b][/center]
[center][/center]

Downloads.Description: Tiny hotfix for an indoor-to-outdoor lighting edge case. With that fixed, Time Chapter is now in a really good place and will likely rest for a while. For now, it can simply sit back and enjoy the moment.
